scope: API and integration feasibility only. No BetterMakati runtime integration is implemented in this step.

dataModel.importantGap: The exposed Person and CongressMembership schemas do not include electoral district, province, city, constituency or party affiliation. BetterMakati cannot safely discover 'Makati representatives' from geography through this API alone.

documents: date range where supported by route
filtersAndSearch.note: Document search is text-oriented. A query for 'Makati' can find titles/abstracts mentioning Makati, but that does not mean the bill is sponsored by, limited to, or primarily about Makati.

accessAndOperations.authentication: Current API is public for read endpoints; repository documentation says authentication is not implemented.
accessAndOperations.rateLimiting: Current repository documentation says no rate limiting is implemented.
accessAndOperations.cors: No CORS middleware was found in the inspected current API source. Do not assume direct browser calls from bettermakati.org are supported.
accessAndOperations.pagination: List endpoints use limit/offset with a maximum of 100 where implemented.
accessAndOperations.dataAccuracy: The live portal explicitly warns that data is manually encoded and may contain inaccuracies.
accessAndOperations.license: API repository is CC0. Individual source documents and linked data should retain their own source/provenance context.

betterMakatiFit.use: After BetterMakati independently verifies the Makati officeholder, match that person to an Open Congress person ID and show neutral legislative records/authored documents.
betterMakatiFit.constraint: Do not infer constituency from the Open Congress person record because geographic representation is not exposed in the current schema.

betterMakatiFit.use: Surface national bills whose text clearly concerns Makati, with congress, bill number, title, date and source/PDF links.
betterMakatiFit.constraint: Text search relevance must be reviewed. A title match is not evidence that a measure became law or that a current official supports it.

betterMakatiFit.use: Deep-link document metadata, authors and source/PDF records for cited national legislation.
betterMakatiFit.constraint: Prefer official House/Senate/Lawphil sources for legal status and enacted-law claims.

betterMakatiFit.use: Use structured bill metadata where a BetterMakati report discusses a specific national measure affecting Makati.
betterMakatiFit.constraint: No scoring, ranking or evaluative political labels.

technicalFindings.finding: Current code exposes document-oriented routes, not the older /bills paths described in API.md.
No geographic constituency fields are exposed for people or memberships.
technicalFindings.consequence: Resolve Makati officeholders from BetterMakati's independently verified records first, then map by person identity. Never discover representatives by assuming a name or district from this API.

technicalFindings.finding: Document records include authors, congress, title/long title, filing date, scope, subjects, Senate permalink and downloadable source/PDF links where available.
technicalFindings.consequence: The API can add useful legislative provenance without BetterMakati duplicating the full national legislative database.

technicalFindings.finding: The live site warns that records are manually encoded and may contain errors.
technicalFindings.consequence: Treat Open Congress as a structured secondary source. Keep official legislative sources primary for legal status, current membership and authoritative text.

technicalFindings.finding: No CORS middleware is present in the inspected API source.
technicalFindings.consequence: Prefer server/build-time fetches or static cached extracts until cross-origin behavior is separately verified.

integrationDecision.reason: Useful structured legislative metadata is available, but current data-quality warnings, missing constituency fields and unverified cross-origin support make a direct browser dependency inappropriate.

nextStep.scope: Implement exactly one Open Congress use case.
nextStep.recommendedUseCase: Add a reviewed, cached Makati-related national legislation feed to the BetterMakati Legislation page using /api/search/documents or the matching open-congress-data records.
guardrails: Include only records whose title/long title clearly identifies a Makati connection after manual review.
Show congress, bill number, title and filing date as descriptive facts only.
Link to the Open Congress record and any available official/source PDF.
Do not describe a bill as enacted, pending, supported or opposed without an official source that establishes that status.
Do not rank legislators, bills or political actors.
Cache the reviewed subset locally so the page does not depend on Open Congress availability.
